docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:17.source: 只有显式 enabled=false 才禁用该 Elwisp。
docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:17.translation: This Elwisp is disabled only when enabled=false is explicitly set.

docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:1b.source: handler 执行及响应写出期限；direct 模式可能包含外部 I/O，因此默认较宽松。
docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:1b.translation: Timeout for handler execution and response writing; direct mode may involve external I/O, so the default is more lenient.

docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:3c.source: Elnis 总开关；false 时不启动 HTTP runtime。
docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:3c.translation: Elnis master switch; if false, the HTTP runtime will not start.

docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:3e.source: llm 模式后台 worker 数。
docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:3e.translation: Number of background workers in LLM mode.

docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:46.source: Elwisp 默认启用；只有需要限制 token、覆盖投递策略或禁用时才配置。
docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:46.translation: Elwisp is enabled by default; configure it only when you need to limit tokens, override delivery policies, or disable it.

docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:51.source: 建议先绑定本地地址，需要暴露时再用反代或内网转发。
docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:51.translation: It is recommended to bind to a local address first, and use a reverse proxy or intranet forwarding when exposure is needed.

docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:7f.source: 单个 Elvena 请求 body 上限。
docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:7f.translation: Request body limit for a single Elvena request.

docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:90.source: 外部工具默认允许，此处只禁用指定工具。
docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:90.translation: External tools are allowed by default; only specified tools are disabled here.

docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:92.source: 默认允许 Elwisp 预加载的 ElBot 内部工具。
docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:92.translation: By default, ElBot internal tools preloaded by Elwisp are allowed.

docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:a2.source: llm 模式后台队列长度。
docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:a2.translation: Background queue length for LLM mode.

docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:b0.source: { platform = "telegram" }, # 禁用 telegram 整个平台所有投递。
docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:b0.translation: { platform = "telegram" }, # Disable all deliveries for the entire telegram platform.

docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:b2.source: 整个请求（含 body）读取期限。
docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:b2.translation: Read timeout for the entire request (including body).

docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:c2.source: 从系统环境变量或配置目录 .env 读取。
docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:c2.translation: Read from system environment variables or the .env file in the configuration directory.

docs/elnis-usage.md:code-comment:toml:e2.translation: Overrides the top-level allowed_tools when present.

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:084fd672b4e1859.source: **workspace**：普通工作文件继续由 sandbox 管理；报告附件在确定需要持久化投递时导入中心。
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:084fd672b4e1859.translation: **workspace**: Ordinary work files continue to be managed by the sandbox; report attachments are imported into the center when persistent delivery is determined to be necessary.

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:0ea8e932f1c03de.source: **成功发送后**：与对应平台消息关联，供后续引用回复使用（无法确定对应关系时不建立猜测关联）。
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:0ea8e932f1c03de.translation: **After successful sending**: Associated with the corresponding platform message for subsequent reference replies (speculative associations are not created when the correspondence cannot be determined).

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:350f87b373d0e8c.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ URI 仅支持 base64 编码且解码后同样受限；
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:350f87b373d0e8c.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ URIs only support base64 encoding and are similarly restricted after decoding;

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:3ec4615c8cd49e2.source: **限制**：文件大小受 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 的 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 限制（默认 100MB）；
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:3ec4615c8cd49e2.translation: **Limit**: File size is restricted by the __ELBOT_CODE_1__ of __ELBOT_CODE_0__ (default 100MB);

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:434528cd60d0bad.source: **token**：原文不写入配置，放系统环境变量或配置目录 __ELBOT_CODE_0__；
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:434528cd60d0bad.translation: **token**: Do not write the plain text into the configuration; place it in system environment variables or the configuration directory __ELBOT_CODE_0__;

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:501bc5fdbf7c134.source: 同样支持 image/file 输出，平台不支持时自动降级为文字描述。
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:501bc5fdbf7c134.translation: Similarly supports image/file output, automatically falling back to text descriptions when the platform does not support them.

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:509b9b255fbd080.source: **direct**：有实际投递目标时导入或复用 Media Center 媒体，不保留 Elnis sandbox 下载副本；
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:509b9b255fbd080.translation: **direct**: Import or reuse Media Center media when there is an actual delivery target, without keeping a downloaded copy in the Elnis sandbox;

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:5242c4840074e1a.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 只能选 __ELBOT_CODE_1__，不能指定任意内部模式名。
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:5242c4840074e1a.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ can only select __ELBOT_CODE_1__, and cannot specify any arbitrary internal mode name.

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:53a4df19564f330.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 也可填 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 引用中心资源。
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:53a4df19564f330.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ can also be filled with __ELBOT_CODE_1__ to reference central resources.

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:54ce965db86ac69.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 支持多个变量名按顺序尝试；
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:54ce965db86ac69.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ supports multiple variable names to be tried in order;

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:5c6d736596b8e68.source: 外部工具调用由 Elnis 对声明的 endpoint 发起 HTTP JSON POST；外部工具自身负责实际风险边界，Elnis 侧按 low 风险处理。
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:5c6d736596b8e68.translation: External tool calls are initiated by Elnis as HTTP JSON POST requests to the declared endpoint; the external tool itself is responsible for the actual risk boundary, and Elnis handles it as low-risk.

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:62a744b0b6e7b92.translation: Local protocols such as __ELBOT_CODE_0__ are prohibited.

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:7507401aafd08ba.source: 需要接收事件时用 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 或 __ELBOT_CODE_1__。
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:7507401aafd08ba.translation: Use __ELBOT_CODE_0__ or __ELBOT_CODE_1__ when receiving events is required.

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:7b7f4247ac055fc.source: 缓存过期只释放关联引用，Session、Transcript、fork 和待重试报告的独立引用仍保留。
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:7b7f4247ac055fc.translation: Cache expiration only releases associated references; independent references for Sessions, Transcripts, forks, and reports pending retry are still retained.

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:8075202ef11bd8a.source: 宿主在准备报告时导入附件，outbox 保存稳定媒体 ID，因此原 workspace 文件删除后仍可重试。
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:8075202ef11bd8a.translation: The host imports attachments when preparing the report, and the outbox saves stable media IDs; therefore, retries are still possible after the original workspace files are deleted.

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:8f2d9c46f5c397c.source: **启动条件**：__ELBOT_CODE_0__ 时不启动 Elnis HTTP runtime。
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:8f2d9c46f5c397c.translation: **Startup Conditions**: Elnis HTTP runtime does not start when __ELBOT_CODE_0__.

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:9a4dcc5d10041a9.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 填当前任务工作目录内的相对路径，不能用绝对路径、__ELBOT_CODE_1__、__ELBOT_CODE_2__ 或逃逸目录的 symlink/junction；已有 HTTP(S) 来源仍兼容。
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:9a4dcc5d10041a9.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ should be filled with a relative path within the current task working directory; absolute paths, __ELBOT_CODE_1__, __ELBOT_CODE_2__, or symlinks/junctions that escape the directory are not allowed. Existing HTTP(S) sources remain compatible.

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:9c597d6b271b08c.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 中的名字都会经过 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 裁决。
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:9c597d6b271b08c.translation: Names in __ELBOT_CODE_0__ will all be subject to adjudication by __ELBOT_CODE_1__.

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:a0c542f7c0db0fd.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 限制哪些 token 可代表该 Elwisp 投递，不写则允许任意已认证 token。
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:a0c542f7c0db0fd.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ restricts which tokens can represent this Elwisp for delivery; if left blank, any authenticated token is allowed.

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:b4ef0dc6a0cd251.source: **孤儿清理**：所有引用消失后经过 1 小时宽限期，媒体维护任务才清理本体和记录；删除失败保留状态供重试。
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:b4ef0dc6a0cd251.translation: **Orphan Cleanup**: After all references disappear and a 1-hour grace period passes, the media maintenance task cleans up the entity and its record; if deletion fails, the state is preserved for retry.

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:b66950c3f121589.source: 外部 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 默认允许，并通过 ToolRun 以 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 形式注入为模型可调用函数名；
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:b66950c3f121589.translation: External __ELBOT_CODE_0__ are allowed by default and are injected via ToolRun in the form of __ELBOT_CODE_1__ as function names callable by the model;

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:b74c3f5c5080227.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 是 CLI-only 模式，即使 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 也不启动 Elnis HTTP runtime；
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:b74c3f5c5080227.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is CLI-only mode; Elnis HTTP runtime does not start even if __ELBOT_CODE_1__;

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:bbd686149054409.source: **llm**：输入在实际执行时物化为稳定媒体 ID，Session 保存 ID，请求发送前再解析。
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:bbd686149054409.translation: **llm**: Input is materialized into a stable media ID during actual execution; the Session saves the ID, which is then resolved before the request is sent.

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:bda0c3841e62076.source: Elwisp 不能绕过 Tool Runtime 和 Security Policy 调用内部工具；
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:bda0c3841e62076.translation: Elwisp cannot bypass Tool Runtime and Security Policy to call internal tools;

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:c032f9b94ffea2e.source: **文件名**：已有扩展名（包括 __ELBOT_CODE_0__）时保留原名，仅无扩展名时补全。
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:c032f9b94ffea2e.translation: **File name**: The original name is preserved if an extension already exists (including __ELBOT_CODE_0__); it is only completed when no extension is present.

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:ce044b9ed5ef1d0.source: 独立 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 进程需连接服务端后才能收到通知。
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:ce044b9ed5ef1d0.translation: Independent __ELBOT_CODE_0__ processes must connect to the server before they can receive notifications.

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:ce8980c3b8a5dc9.source: **已发送缓存**：保留期复用 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 的 __ELBOT_CODE_1__，非正值不保留；
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:ce8980c3b8a5dc9.translation: **Sent cache**: The retention period reuses __ELBOT_CODE_0__'s __ELBOT_CODE_1__; it is not retained if the value is not positive;

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:d52948ff0fde6dd.source: **发送中 / outbox 待重试**：保留有效引用。
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:d52948ff0fde6dd.translation: **Sending / outbox pending retry**: Keep valid references.

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:ed70eecd0ef8b98.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 只在两种情况生效：Elnis 与 CLI 同处一个 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 前台进程，或 service 模式启用了 CLI 远程服务端。
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:ed70eecd0ef8b98.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ only takes effect in two cases: Elnis and CLI are in the same __ELBOT_CODE_1__ foreground process, or service mode has enabled the CLI remote server.

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:f05de9594a7ea18.source: 只写 __ELBOT_CODE_0__：投递到该平台超级管理员。
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:f05de9594a7ea18.translation: Only write __ELBOT_CODE_0__: deliver to the superadmin of that platform.

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:f39229c76045b05.source: **按需下载**：record、拒绝、重复或仅排队的事件不下载来源媒体；排队任务已有的媒体 ID 会建立引用。
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:f39229c76045b05.translation: **Download on demand**: Events that are recorded, rejected, duplicated, or only queued will not download source media; references will be established for media IDs already existing in queued tasks.

docs/elnis-usage.md:list:fbd77ed6a461d7d.source: 单个 Elwisp 可用 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 禁用。
docs/elnis-usage.md:list:fbd77ed6a461d7d.translation: A single Elwisp can be disabled using __ELBOT_CODE_0__.

docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:01f2e6ae6d.source: direct/record 请求中 __ELBOT_CODE_0__、__ELBOT_CODE_1__、__ELBOT_CODE_2__ 至少提供一个；
docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:01f2e6ae6d.translation: In a direct/record request, at least one of __ELBOT_CODE_0__, __ELBOT_CODE_1__, or __ELBOT_CODE_2__ must be provided;

docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:3b1511c0ed.source: 命中 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 或单 Elwisp __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 时才禁止。
docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:3b1511c0ed.translation: It is only prohibited when __ELBOT_CODE_0__ or a single Elwisp __ELBOT_CODE_1__ is hit.

docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:4bf90b5417.source: Elnis 默认关闭。启用时先在 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 中声明配置文件入口：
docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:4bf90b5417.translation: Elnis is disabled by default. When enabling it, first declare the configuration file entry in __ELBOT_CODE_0__:

docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:4ff708008a.source: 该任务复用 sandbox 的清理时间表，但不按目录文件年龄删 Media Center 内容。
docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:4ff708008a.translation: This task reuses the sandbox cleanup schedule, but does not delete Media Center content based on the age of directory files.

docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:5a9b0b9287.source: 本文承接 [Elnis 监听枢纽](elnis.md)，讲如何启用 Elnis、配置 Elwisp 策略，并用 Elvena 投递事件。
docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:5a9b0b9287.translation: This article follows [Elnis listening hub](elnis.md) and explains how to enable Elnis, configure Elwisp policies, and use Elvena to deliver events.

docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:68e5bf428d.source: 同一个 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 再次发送会返回 duplicate，不重复分发。
docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:68e5bf428d.translation: Sending the same __ELBOT_CODE_0__ again will return "duplicate" and it will not be redistributed.

docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:70c205c61d.source: 这个事件只执行 API，不发送额外消息。
docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:70c205c61d.translation: This event only executes the API and does not send additional messages.

docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:74d9bfb1c1.source: 禁用配置中的 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 表示禁用该平台所有投递。
docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:74d9bfb1c1.translation: Setting __ELBOT_CODE_0__ in the disable configuration means disabling all deliveries for this platform.

docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:97298a2cad.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 用于发送图片和文件，__ELBOT_CODE_1__ 保留为纯文本 fallback。
docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:97298a2cad.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is used to send images and files, while __ELBOT_CODE_1__ is reserved as a plain text fallback.

docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:9d71797485.source: 后台 LLM 处理事件后，__ELBOT_CODE_0__ 的 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 可附带图片 / 文件：
docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:9d71797485.translation: After the background LLM processes the event, the __ELBOT_CODE_1__ of __ELBOT_CODE_0__ can include images / files:

docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:ad681407d4.source: 达到宽限期后在**下一次**维护任务执行时清理，不是一小时整立即删除。
docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:ad681407d4.translation: After the grace period expires, cleanup occurs during the **next** execution of the maintenance task, rather than being deleted immediately at the exact one-hour mark.

docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:b3945dbab2.translation: LLM mode still requires __ELBOT_CODE_0__ to be provided.

docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:b7180c8fcb.source: QQ OneBot、QQ Official、Telegram 支持在引用回复中恢复关联媒体：回复自己 Session 的最后一条 assistant 消息会恢复该 Session，回复更早的则从该位置 Fork。
docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:b7180c8fcb.translation: QQ OneBot, QQ Official, and Telegram support restoring associated media in quoted replies: replying to the last assistant message of one's own Session will restore that Session, while replying to an earlier message will Fork from that position.

docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:cd1efccdfc.source: 通过 QQ OneBot 原生接口 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 撤回消息，__ELBOT_CODE_1__ 为平台消息 ID。
docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:cd1efccdfc.translation: Withdraw a message via the QQ OneBot native interface __ELBOT_CODE_0__, where __ELBOT_CODE_1__ is the platform message ID.

docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:ceb0f5dd41.source: 启动后可用 curl 测试一个 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 事件：
docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:ceb0f5dd41.translation: After starting, you can use curl to test a __ELBOT_CODE_0__ event:

docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:d123f0b377.source: Elwisp 远端工具仅操作自己的文件，不获得宿主媒体导出路径、RPC 或存储凭据。
docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:d123f0b377.translation: Elwisp remote tools only operate on their own files and do not obtain host media export paths, RPC, or storage credentials.

docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:d9d26abbf8.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 为空时行为不变；非空时优先按 segments 渲染，__ELBOT_CODE_1__ 作为附加文本。
docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:d9d26abbf8.translation: Behavior remains unchanged when __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is empty; when not empty, it is rendered according to segments by priority, with __ELBOT_CODE_1__ serving as additional text.

docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:f538146eef.source: 宽限期起点存在数据库里，关闭 ElBot 的时间也计入、重启不重置；
docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:f538146eef.translation: The start of the grace period is stored in the database; time spent with ElBot shut down is also counted, and it is not reset upon restart;

docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:f95f134b61.source: 媒体引用分四级，按顺序释放：
docs/elnis-usage.md:paragraph:f95f134b61.translation: Media references are divided into four levels and are released in the following order:

docs/elnis-usage.md:table:008fe9c8720c3d.source: direct/record 可为空，但 __ELBOT_CODE_0__、__ELBOT_CODE_1__、__ELBOT_CODE_2__ 至少提供一个。
docs/elnis-usage.md:table:008fe9c8720c3d.translation: direct/record can be empty, but at least one of __ELBOT_CODE_0__, __ELBOT_CODE_1__, or __ELBOT_CODE_2__ must be provided.

docs/elnis-usage.md:table:04c5b32ea0692b.source: 仅 __ELBOT_CODE_0__、__ELBOT_CODE_1__、__ELBOT_CODE_2__；未填或对应槽位未配置时回退 __ELBOT_CODE_3__。
docs/elnis-usage.md:table:04c5b32ea0692b.translation: Only __ELBOT_CODE_0__, __ELBOT_CODE_1__, __ELBOT_CODE_2__; falls back to __ELBOT_CODE_3__ if left blank or the corresponding slot is not configured.

docs/elnis-usage.md:table:05a363aa4f244a.source: 具体事件源，例如服务名、脚本名、RSS 名。
docs/elnis-usage.md:table:05a363aa4f244a.translation: Specific event source, such as service name, script name, or RSS name.

docs/elnis-usage.md:table:076d83da249559.source: 平台原生 API 调用数组。
docs/elnis-usage.md:table:076d83da249559.translation: An array of platform native API calls.

docs/elnis-usage.md:table:0e88874c152f1e.source: Elwisp 名称，也是来源身份之一；仅允许英文字母、数字、__ELBOT_CODE_0__、__ELBOT_CODE_1__，不允许点号。
docs/elnis-usage.md:table:0e88874c152f1e.translation: Elwisp name, which is also one of the source identities; only English letters, numbers, __ELBOT_CODE_0__, and __ELBOT_CODE_1__ are allowed; dots are not allowed.

docs/elnis-usage.md:table:29909a48460a93.source: direct 请求只有 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 且无 __ELBOT_CODE_1__/__ELBOT_CODE_2__ 时只执行 API，不发消息。
docs/elnis-usage.md:table:29909a48460a93.translation: For direct requests, if only __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is present and there are no __ELBOT_CODE_1__/__ELBOT_CODE_2__, only the API is executed and no message is sent.

docs/elnis-usage.md:table:2cb9d988869c02.source: Elwisp 随事件声明的外部工具；默认允许，命中该 Elwisp 的 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 时拒绝。
docs/elnis-usage.md:table:2cb9d988869c02.translation: External tools declared by Elwisp with events; allowed by default, rejected when hitting the __ELBOT_CODE_0__ of that Elwisp.
